text:
maria: Quick sync — change window Sun 02:00 UTC. Plan is a staggered shift to roll the console->router header split. Need a clear handback sequence across API, runtime, console, router. Who's shepherding what?
aj: I can own API + release notes. Proposal: pin API to v2.10.0-canary for the wave, runtime pinned to v3.5.0-rc1 for canary only. Console will be a guarded rollout (schema checks).
tim: I will shepherd runtime + routing. Main concern: KV eviction during the header flip. Suggest increasing KV grace to 120s (default 60s) for the window.
sarah: Ops will watch traffic steering and be ready to rollback. Proposed rollback triggers: error-rate > 1.0% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency > 2.0s for 5m. Manual abort allowed anytime.
maria: Good. AJ, include the rollback triggers and KV-grace note in the release notes + runbook. Also we need the feature-flag toggle path ready.
aj: Will do. Release notes draft will call out pinned versions, canary waves, and feature flag `console.feature.header_split`. I'll add a runbook snippet with the abort commands.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for thread 1777771001 at 02:00 UTC. Wave config: [10% -> 25% -> 50%], 10m evaluation windows.
tim: Sequence we should follow: 1) push console patch (schema-compatible), 2) push runtime/API canary, 3) once canary stable, flip router header rewrite. Do NOT flip router before console.
sarah: Canary monitors I'm standing up: synthetic schema permutations, backend token-routing validation, and token-level latency. I'll create a short dashboard and add it to the release console.
aj: Small note — no DB migrations here, but console matcher must be backwards-compatible. Add a guarded matcher that accepts old + new headers to avoid rejections.
tim: If runtime memory or `kv.evictions` spike in canary, that's an immediate rollback. I'll annotate dashboards with `runtime.vmem` and `kv.evictions` and set alert thresholds.
maria: Decision: pin API -> `v2.10.0-canary`, runtime -> `v3.5.0-rc1` for canary, console -> `v1.12.3-guarded`. Router will remain at `v4.0.0` until final verification.
aj: Pushing release notes PR now. I'll include a short preflight checklist in the PR body (feature flag path, pinned versions, runbook links). Will post TL;DR in #eng-releases before window.
sarah: Who's primary on-call during the window? I'll be primary, Tim secondary, Maria will handle product comms.
tim: I'll run a dry-run in staging tonight: `deploy-bot dry-run --wave 10,25` and post results here.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dry-run initiated by tim at 22:10 UTC. Preflight result: OK. No KV eviction observed in staging. Logs: `preflight: ok` (attach: staging-preflight.log).
aj: Thanks — please add the canary abort example to the runbook: `deploy-bot abort --thread 1777771001` and fallback route command: `router.set-route legacy`.
maria: Copy that. Locking the change window and moving to commit. Everyone good?
aj: :thumbsup: API side is good.
tim: :thumbsup: runtime green.
sarah: Ops green. I'll post a 30m before-hand reminder and own the traffic steering.
maria: :rocket: Adding rollout note to the release calendar and pinging support with the TL;DR.
